outputs.final_proof:
\begin{proof}
Since $|z|=1$, we have $z\bar z=1$. Therefore,
\[
|1+z|^2=(1+z)(1+\bar z)=2+z+\bar z,
\]
and
\[
|1-z|^2=(1-z)(1-\bar z)=2-z-\bar z.
\]
Adding these identities gives
\[
|1+z|^2+|1-z|^2=4.
\]
\end{proof}
